_comment: Hand-computed ground truth for fixtures/duplicates.csv, consumed by both frontend/tests/scoring.test.ts and backend/tests/test_duplicate_score_determinism.py. rowId convention: 1-indexed data row -> 'row-N' (header excluded). Rather than enumerating all C(8,2) pairs, this lists the pairs the scoring engine MUST surface (exact score/band/signals) and a pair it MUST prune (score below the 35-point surfacing threshold) so cross-language and repeat-run determinism can be asserted without hand-verifying every unrelated pair combination.

expectedPairs.reasonSummary: 100% — email exact match (+40); phone exact match (normalized) (+30); name exact match (+20); address 100% similar (Levenshtein) (+10)
50% — name exact match (+20); email username matches, domain differs (+15); phone matches ignoring area code/extension (+15)
79% — email exact match (+40); phone matches ignoring area code/extension (+15); name 92% similar (Levenshtein) (+14); address 100% similar (Levenshtein) (+10)

prunedPairs.note: Scores below 35 (name_fuzzy ~14pts + address_fuzzy ~9pts = ~23); must NOT appear in duplicate-candidate output.
